Very hydrating mask! These masks are really great for hydration. After every one of them, my skin feels fresh/moisturized/plump. There is a very slight tackiness left behind, but nothing too sticky. I didn’t experience any irritation at all. I have acne-prone oily sensitive skin for reference. I loved all of the masks in this set, except for the coffee one. It doesn’t smell like coffee, it smells like fake tanning lotion. I can’t stand that smell, and don’t like having it lingering on my skin. Other than that, it performed nicely. I just can’t fully relax with a scent I don’t like. But the others in the set are really nice. Cute names and art on the packets. The masks fit my face well and were comfortable to wear. They do have enough stretch in the material to kind of custom fit it to my face. Plenty of skincare included on each mask and in the packets. Overall, a nice set of sheet masks minus the fake tanner smelling one.

avis.titre: Fun to try but not a necessity
avis.texte: These Zealsea natural sheet masks immediately caught my attention because they’re cute, colorful, and fun-looking. The packaging is adorable, especially with the little dolphin design, and each mask has its own unique look depending on the type, which makes them feel playful and appealing right out of the box. I tried the Avocado Moisturizing Mask. When I first opened it, I noticed there was no scent at all, which was a little disappointing. I wasn’t expecting it to smell like avocado, but I did expect at least a light essence or aroma. Instead, it’s completely neutral. The mask itself is a standard full-coverage sheet mask with cutouts for the eyes, nose, and mouth. It fit my face well and stayed in place easily. I followed the directions, cleansed my face, and left it on for 15 minutes. Unlike some masks, there was no tingling or sensation, so you don’t really “feel” it working — which could be a positive or negative depending on what you prefer. After removing the mask, I used an icy face roller to help massage the remaining product into my skin. That made a big difference. Once fully absorbed, my skin definitely felt moisturized and smooth. It didn’t leave my skin sticky as long as I worked the product in properly. If you don’t massage or roll it in, you may notice some dried product sitting on the skin, which isn’t my favorite, but it’s manageable. I do like that these masks are all natural, which makes them feel safe and gentle. I think this would be a fun product to us

avis.titre: Fun to try out and remember to wash off
avis.texte: I was excited receiving these masks as they have so many varieties that I can try out. 7 kinds of with 2 of each. The essence is on the light side which doesn’t put too much burden on my oil-normal skin. While 2 masks of one kind is not sufficient to see any significant change, either brighten the skin or reduce fine lines, the varieties did help to encourage using them. On the down side, as other comments mentioned that they were designed in Korea but actually made in China; also, I will recommend to wash off afterwards instead of leaving in.

avis.titre: Do not pass up on these super cute mask
avis.texte: Let's start by talking about how cute these mask's are. They are just so bright and happy. I was in love before even trying them. The package was easy to open and so was the unfolding of the actual mask to apply to your face. The actual mask was a little big, but I have a very small face. The minute I applied my mask by ZealSea it felt instantly refreshing. After removing the mask, my face felt very soft and smooth. Have not seen any long term effects, but for the price and cuteness factor, these mask's make a awesome gift or wonderful for a spa night at home with a group of friends.

avis.titre: Cute Seal Design but Not Much Moisturization - Hard to Use
avis.texte: The order of the ZealSea face mask comes in 14 packs. Each mask is packaged individually. There are two (2) masks of 7 different ingredients - aloe, orange, avocado, coffee, pomegranate, green tea. The product is "fun" with all the seal anmial design on the product varying by these different ingredients. Unfortunately, there is nothing special about these face mask other than the cute packing. The product is labeled as Korean Face Mask which if you know, Korea is known for their k-beauty products. I ordered the masks without questioning it but found the fine prints on the product that reads "Design in Korea" and "Made in China." The packaging is difficult to open. The folded masks enclosed in the packaging is even more difficult to open and unfold. There is not much moisturizing serum in the packaging. I also did not detect much of a scent either on the mask. I felt the product did not much moisturizing and was disappointed.

*I have sensitive + combination skin that tends to get really dry during the winter season. Brought these masks as part of my daily beauty routine for the winter. Sadly, after trying out all 7 types of masks for a whole entire week straight, none of them are moisturizing enough for my skin. Though they did not irritate my skin, a few of the masks left a rather tacky/sticky feeling on my face after use (Honey, Avocado, Aloe). The pomegranate mask has a weird plastic-like scent which I removed and threw away after just 5mins, I couldn't stand the smell of it. The most awkward mask has to be the coffee mask. As you can see in the photos, the liquid from the mask is actually brown in color - Yes, it was extremely messy and it does stain your shirt/pillowcase. Other than being affordable, I would not recommend these masks to anyone. Pay a little extra more for something else.
